# AttemptOutputRefusal

`schemas/records/attempt-output-refusal.json`

The payload of attempt.output_refused/v1 (docs/design/m0/09 "Blob exchange"): the controller refused one adapter output. The event's subject is the attempt. It is not a transition: it leaves the attempt record unchanged and may follow any state, terminal ones included, so it is a record of its own rather than a lease-event transition. An attempt with at least one such event is untrustworthy; M0 derives that at read time. reason is stale_attempt exactly when check is (05 fencing), unsafe_output otherwise.

| Field | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `attempt` | yes | [AttemptID](common-defs.md#attemptid) |  |
| `handle` | yes | object ([fields](#fields-of-handle)) | The handle as the adapter declared it (adapter/event.json AdapterHandle), with its name unconstrained so that a path refusal can record it; for foreign_handle its attempt is not the event's. |
| `reason` | yes | one of `unsafe_output`, `stale_attempt` |  |
| `check` | yes | one of `stale_attempt`, `foreign_handle`, `path`, `symlink`, `special_file`, `hard_link`, `size`, `unreadable`, `digest`, `replaced` | The first check that refused the output, in 09's ingestion order. |
| `detail` | yes | string (minLength `1`, maxLength `1024`) | What the check saw; never file contents. |

No other fields are allowed.

Conditional rules (1, `if`/`then`/`else` in the schema):

- when `check` `stale_attempt`, then `reason` `stale_attempt`; otherwise `reason` `unsafe_output`
